findings.title: Grayling Hospital labor and delivery transitions to reopened Otsego Memorial Hospital Birthing Center effective October 29
findings.exact_supporting_passage: will transition to the newly expanded and renovated Otsego Memorial Hospital beginning Thursday, Oct. 29, at 6:15 a.m.
findings.service_line: Hospital labor and delivery; inpatient maternity/birthing center
findings.access_consequences: Munson Healthcare's announced transition took effect October 29 at 6:15 a.m.: inpatient deliveries previously provided in Grayling are redirected to expanded Otsego Memorial Hospital in Gaylord, where the birthing center had been temporarily unavailable since August 1, 2025. Grayling and Prudenville retain outpatient OB/GYN visits and Grayling retains gynecologic surgery. Otsego birthing center capacity expands to seven labor/delivery/recovery/postpartum rooms. Exact real-world patient acceptance at the hour of this recall has not been independently observed; official provider announcement supplies the effective date.
findings.affected_population: Northern Michigan expectant families relying on Grayling Hospital labor and delivery, including Crawford County residents; families in Gaylord/Otsego County regain local delivery access; counts unknown.

findings.title: Mercy Health to discontinue labor and delivery at St. Joseph Warren Hospital by early December
findings.exact_supporting_passage: discontinuing deliveries at St. Joseph Warren Hospital by early December
findings.service_line: Hospital labor and delivery; inpatient obstetrics/newborn
findings.access_consequences: Mercy Health announced a decided consolidation, not merely a proposal: St. Joseph Warren Hospital deliveries are to end by early December 2026 and move to St. Elizabeth Boardman Hospital. Prenatal and postpartum care will continue through established providers; Warren's former birthing unit will be repurposed as a 25-bed inpatient ward. Receiving Boardman hospital plans 20 additional maternity beds. Closure not yet effective during observation; exact December date unspecified.
findings.affected_population: Warren and Trumbull County residents needing inpatient childbirth services; no patient count specified.
